text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho is over, and the
Japanese Derby
is fast approaching
when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What is this? A "BNW Special Feature"?
What
does BNW mean?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it. It must stand for "Biwa
Hayahide,"
"Нарита Таисин," and
"Уиннинг Тикит."
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Pfft. Talk about unimaginative.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин acts unimpressed, but it's
easy to
see the joy in her expression.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Public opinion has completely changed
following
Нарита Таисин's impressive run
in the Satsuki Sho.
The era of the "top
two" has ended, and all focus
is now on
the BNW trio!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
Let's throw everything we've got at the
Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.text: Sure.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Can we end the meeting now? Cool, I'm
gonna
get going.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: TAISHIIIIIN!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Gah?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
You again! Learn to dial down that
defeaning
voice of yours!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Sorry! But I really...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Reeeaaally wanna have a scrimmage with you!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит's unstoppable
enthusiasm
practically teleports us to
the racecourse.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I had wanted Нарита Таисин to take it
easy since
she was done training for the
day, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Stop worrying so much. It's just a
scrimmage. I've
got enough energy left
for one more.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Anyway...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Ticket might be the biggest dum-dum in
the
world...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
But the way she puts her heart and soul
into the
Derby is the real deal.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Don't you think it'd be worthwhile to see
what she
can do?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Taishin! I'm ready—let's gooo!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I'll be back.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Ka-chak!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The scrimmage between Нарита Таисин
and
Уиннинг Тикит begins!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's a 2,400-meter run on turf, the same
as the
Japanese Derby. Уиннинг Тикит
is pushing hard
from the get-go.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She seems to be on the offensive as she
races
down the track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Once they enter the final straight,
Уиннинг Тикит
releases a fearsome burst
of speed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: You're not gonna get the better of me!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин's just as unrelenting. Her
last sprint
is as amazing as ever—or
rather, it's gotten more
fierce since the
Satsuki Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yaaahhh!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
In the last 200 meters, Нарита Таисин
manages to
push her nose ahead of
Уиннинг Тикит for a
moment, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Derby! Derby, Derby, Deeerrrbyyy!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I won't let you take the Derby crown
away from
meee!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Agh!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: The dust clears...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит manages to claw back
the lead
and win the scrimmage by a
nose.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... huff...
text_block_list.name: The Two

text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Huff... Phew! Thank you, Taishiiin!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Sigh. Who thanks their opponent after royally thrashing them? Way to tick me off.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I managed to win today, but you
know
what?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I was only able to do it because I saw
you race at
the Satsuki Sho.
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
You really are amazing, Taishin! You're

super-duper strong! But that's why I
gotta get
strong too!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I need to become strong enough to beat
you if I
wanna fulfill my dream and
become a Derby
champion!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
When I train, all I think about is beating

you—about winning no matter what!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Then you must be happy with
your win
today.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Not at all! This wasn't the real Derby, and I only barely won.
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Besides! You're totally gonna get even
faster by
the time the Derby comes
around!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: No duh.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Raaaaah! That's why I gotta, gotta, gotta train more too!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Later, Taishiiiiin!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
How can she still run like that? Where
does she
keep all that energy?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Hey, you were watching, right? You saw
how fast
Ticket was?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Good. I'll see you at tomorrow's meeting.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
We've gotta come up with a training
regimen to
defeat her!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
To challenge and be challenged—they
push each
other further ahead. Having a
rival who so
earnestly pursues her dream
is a great influence
on Taishin.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: At least, that's what I thought.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Raaaaah! Deeerbyyyyy!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Just a dream, huh...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
